start: Today page as owner; waiting: 2 plan requests, 1 check-in number, 1 shop order, 3 member questions, 1 member message

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: 'Needs you' with one line per kind: '2 plan requests from the app to approve', '1 check-in number to confirm', '1 new shop order to get ready', '3 member questions to answer', '1 member message to reply to'; the browser tab title starts '(8)'

steps.action: Answer one item
user_sees: The count goes down by one
